# dsh-llm-pi-ai-image-offload
**中文文档：README.zh-CN.md**

Restores **request-image token pricing** for adapter routes that declare none
— in practice every ro
ute served by `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai`.

Naming: the package is called `image-offload` after the capability it restores,
not after the method

it patches. The patched method is `imageRequestPricing`,
whose job is to price an image in **tokens

** so the budget checks can compare it
against `maxInlineTokens` and offload what does not fit. "Pri

cing" here is token
accounting, not billing.
## The bug this fixes

`LlmAdapter.imageRequestPricing()` returns `undefined` by default, meaning "this
route declares no i

mage pricing". Only `dsh-llm-deepseek` overrides it. pi-ai
does not.

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-spill-policy` asks for that calculator whenever a tool result
carries images:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

That throw is caught by the plugin's own outer `try`, which logs
`spill-policy: ...; keeping the inl

ine content` and **returns nothing**. The tool
result therefore stays completely inline: a multi-meg

abyte base64 image goes to
the provider verbatim and consumes the context window.

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-token-meter` degrades the same way, falling back to a fixed
structural heuristic i
nstead of pricing the bytes actually sent.
## What this plugin does

It installs `imageRequestPricing` on adapter **instances** that return no
pricing, and re-applies on

every `llm/adapters-updated` event.
- An adapter that answers real pricing keeps it (an upstream fi

x retires this
patch automatically).
- An adapter whose implementation *throws* is never replaced.
-

Zero runtime dependencies, so it cannot fail to resolve host packages at load
time. The descriptor

helpers are reproduced byte-for-byte from the shipped
implementation, and the integration test asser

ts that equality against the
real `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm`.
## Pricing model

These routes publish no vision-token accounting, so each occurrence is priced by
the bytes actually

h no vision-token accounting, so each occurrence is priced by
the bytes actually transmitted for it:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

`base64Length(b) = ceil(b / 3) * 4`, matching the harness's own byte accounting.
This is the same un

it `spill-policy` compares against `maxInlineTokens`, which is
what lets it shed an oversized image
instead of keeping it inline.

For the reported failure case — a 2048×2048 JPEG at 1,266,320 bytes on a route
with a 1 MiB request

budget — that is `base64(1048576) / 4 = 349,526` tokens,
comfortably above the default `maxInlineTok

t is `base64(1048576) / 4 = 349,526` tokens,
comfortably above the default `maxInlineTokens: 12500`.
## Config
All fields optional.
| field | default | meaning |

| `enabled` | `true` | turn the patch off entirely |
| `charsPerToken` | `4` | base64 character dens

ity per token |
| `maxVisualTokens` | `400000` | per-occurrence ceiling |
| `providers` | *(all)* |

allowlist of provider route ids |
| `debug` | `false` | log each patched route to the harness logger

lowlist of provider route ids |
| `debug` | `false` | log each patched route to the harness logger |
Example profile patch:

## What the model sees

Shedding does not delete the image from the session, and does not touch the
workspace file. The mode

l receives `spill-policy`'s notice plus a path it can
re-read with `read_image`, so the image is rec
overable rather than lost.
## Verifying it is active

The harness logger writes to an in-memory ring buffer that has no file sink, so a
warn is not observ

able after the fact. Use `debug: true` plus a large generated
image, and check the session log for `

image/offload` events — before this patch
that signal never appears.
## Install
### From GitHub (recommended)
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Pin a commit for a reproducible install:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
### From a local checkout
[代码示例省略，未执行]
### Then activate the bundle

Either install path puts the package in the profile's `node_modules`. Add the
name to `dsh.profile.b
undles` in the profile `package.json`:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The bundle's own `cordis.patch.yml` inserts the host row, so no manual patch
editing is needed. Rest
art the harness afterwards — bundles load at startup.

> `dsh plugin add` writes both `package.json` and `pnpm-lock.yaml`, so the
> install stays consisten
t with the profile's package manager state.
## Tests
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The plugin has zero runtime dependencies, so the unit test runs anywhere. A
separate integration che

ck (not shipped) runs against host modules extracted
from `app.asar` and asserts the descriptor text

is byte-identical to the
shipped `requestImageHandleText` / `offloadedImageText` serializers.
## Risks

- `LlmAdapter` instance fields are not a documented extension point. If the
registry shape changes,

the patch silently does nothing — by design, since a
missing patch restores exactly the pre-existing

behaviour.
- The estimate over-counts routes whose upstream tokenizes as vision. That is
conservati

ve on purpose: it triggers shedding earlier, never later. Provider
`usage` remains the authoritative

riggers shedding earlier, never later. Provider
`usage` remains the authoritative accounting anchor.
